parsed.summary: The PR removes the subquery from the DELETE statement, which resolves the performance regression and compatibility issue with LOCK TABLES. The change is minimal and focused.

issues.description: The PR does not address the case where multiple tables are involved in the delete operation. This could lead to incomplete resolution of the issue.
The code style has changed slightly, which may not align with the project's conventions.
